decisions.reason: By 2022 this core underground loader line has had time to prove itself, and its strong fit with the firm's engineering, parts and service base makes continued commercialization more valuable than withdrawal.

After roughly three years a standalone construction dumper should have revealed enough about demand, and its weaker strategic fit and likely tougher competition reduce the option value of keeping it alive.
The inclined furniture-lift line is a related niche product family with reusable know-how and service synergies, so it still merits retention despite some remaining market uncertainty.

The inclined building-material lift line is close to the firm's lifting and material-handling capabilities and likely shares components and support resources, making it a reasonable option to continue.
The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift looks like the narrowest and most resource-intensive variant, so by now the learning option is largely exhausted and resources are better redeployed.
